name: Saudi Tourist eVisa
summary: Online visit visa for citizens of 72 listed countries, and for people holding a Schengen, US or UK visit visa, permanent residents of the US, EU or UK, or residents of a GCC country. Covers leisure, events, family visits and Umrah. No Hajj, no study.

other: Eligible if you are a citizen of one of the 72 countries on the official list, OR hold a Schengen, US or UK visit visa, OR are a permanent resident of the US, EU or UK, OR live in a GCC country.
Other nationalities can apply through a visa service center or a Saudi embassy.
The official page lists stay as 90 days and does not say if that is per visit or total across the year.

stay.note: Multiple entry visa is valid 1 year with a 90 day stay. A single entry option is valid 90 days with a 90 day stay.

steps: Check your country or status on the official list.
Apply on the KSA Visa or visitsaudi eVisa portal.
Pay the visa fee, digital service fees and mandatory insurance.
processing: The official page says 1 minute to 3 business days.

name: Visit Visa on Arrival
summary: Visit visa issued on arrival for people holding a Schengen, US or UK visit visa, and permanent residents of the US, EU or UK.

other: Fee and stay length on arrival were not listed separately. The online visit visa shows 90 days stay.

name: Electronic Travel Authorization (UK citizens)
summary: Two year multiple entry travel authorization for UK citizens. Allows tourism, business, study and medical treatment. No work or Hajj. Every person, including children, needs their own application.

stay.note: Valid 730 days, stay up to 180 days.

processing: The official page says 1 to 3 working days.

name: Family and Friends Visit Visa
summary: Visit visa to see family or friends living in Saudi Arabia. Same eligibility and fees as the tourist eVisa. Also allows events and Umrah, not Hajj.

other: Citizens of eligible countries, holders of Schengen, US or UK visit visas, permanent residents of the US, EU or UK, and GCC residents can get it as an eVisa. Others use a visa service center or Saudi embassy.

stay.note: Multiple entry is valid 1 year with 90 day stay.

processing: The official page says 1 minute to 3 business days.

name: Umrah Visit Visa
summary: Visit visa for Umrah, open to Muslims of all nationalities. Not available during Hajj season (15 Dhul Qa'dah to 15 Dhul Hijjah). Regular Umrah is arranged through Nusuk and authorized agents. Hajj is separate.

other: Muslims of all nationalities.
Not available from 15 Dhul Qa'dah to 15 Dhul Hijjah.
Direct Umrah applications through the Foreign Ministry are for people with prior embassy approval.

stay.note: Official page shows single entry (90 days) and multiple entry (1 year, 90 day stay).

name: Transit Visas (air, land, sea)
summary: Separate transit visas exist for air layovers, land crossings to a neighboring country, and sea travel with temporary disembarkation. Apply on the KSA Visa platform.

other: Eligibility, allowed hours and fees were not readable on the detail pages. Check ksavisa.sa. A stopover visa program was not confirmed.

name: Work Visa and Iqama (employer sponsored)
summary: An employer in Saudi Arabia arranges the work visa. Types listed are permanent, temporary and seasonal work visas. After arrival the employer arranges the residence permit (iqama).

other: Requirements, fees and iqama rules were not readable on the official pages we could open.

name: Residence Visa for Family
summary: Residence visa for immediate relatives of Saudi citizens and residents. Relatives of citizens can live permanently. Relatives of residents can stay while the resident's residency is valid.

other: Income and document rules were not readable on the official pages we could open.

name: Premium Residency
summary: Residency without a sponsor, run by the Premium Residency Center. Products: Special Talent, Gifted, Business Investor, Entrepreneur, Real Estate Owner, Limited Duration and Unlimited Duration. Holders can bring parents, spouses and kids under 25.

other: Valid passport, proof of financial solvency, clean criminal record, medical report under 6 months old showing no infectious disease.
Applying from inside the country requires legal residence.
Pay the fee within 30 days of approval and buy medical insurance in the kingdom.
Premium Residency does not qualify you for Saudi citizenship.
The center says all conditions can change.

steps: Pay the fee within 30 days of approval.
Buy medical insurance and get the residency issued.

name: Limited Duration Premium Residency
summary: Premium residency for 1 to 5 years, renewable, for people who can show financial solvency. Fee is 100,000 SAR per year.

other: Proof of financial solvency. The page gives no set amount.

sources.label: Limited and Unlimited Duration Premium Residency

name: Unlimited Duration Premium Residency
summary: Permanent premium residency. One-time fee of 800,000 SAR. You need proof of financial solvency.

other: Proof of financial solvency. The page gives no set amount.

sources.label: Limited and Unlimited Duration Premium Residency

name: Special Talent Premium Residency
summary: For researchers, health and scientific talent, and senior executives. 5 years, renewable once. Permanent residency possible after 30 months in the country within 5 years while still meeting the criteria.

eligibility.education: Bachelor's degree or higher (researchers and health and scientific track)
other: Researchers: contract with a listed body in a priority field, at least 14,000 SAR a month, 3+ years related experience, 3 research papers, pass the points system.
Health and scientific talent: listed employer, at least 35,000 SAR a month, 3+ years experience, pass the points system.
Executives: top two leadership levels at a listed body, at least 80,000 SAR a month.
The fee on the page reads '4,000 thousand riyal', which is unclear. Confirm on pr.gov.sa.

name: Gifted Premium Residency
summary: For talent in sports, culture and the arts. 5 years, renewable once. Permanent residency possible after 30 months in the country within 5 years, with a recommendation from the culture or sports ministry.

other: Track one: nominated for or won a listed award, plus financial solvency and a ministry recommendation.
Track two: meet the minimum on the approved criteria list, plus financial solvency and a ministry recommendation.
The fee on the page reads '4,000 thousand riyal', which is unclear. Confirm on pr.gov.sa.

name: Business Investor Premium Residency
summary: Permanent residency straight away for investors with at least 7 million SAR invested and 10 employees. You must keep both for the first 2 years.

investment.note: Minimum share of the applicant. Must stay invested for the first 2 years.

other: Valid investment license from the Ministry of Investment and commercial registration.
Proof of capital paid in and ownership.
10 employees under the applicant's share, shown by the social insurance certificate, kept for the first 2 years.
The fee on the page reads '4,000 thousand riyal', which is unclear. Confirm on pr.gov.sa.

name: Entrepreneur Premium Residency
summary: For founders with an entrepreneur license. Category 1: 5 years, renewable once, with 400,000 SAR raised. Category 2: permanent right away with 15 million SAR raised and 10 new jobs a year for 2 years.

other: Both: entrepreneur license from the Ministry of Investment and funding from an approved investor.
Category 1: at least 400,000 SAR raised, at least 20% stake in the company, renewal needs 30 months in the country within 5 years.
Category 2: at least 15 million SAR raised, at least 10% stake, 10 jobs in year one and 10 more in year two.
The fee on the page reads '4,000 thousand riyal', which is unclear. Confirm on pr.gov.sa.

name: Real Estate Owner Premium Residency
summary: For owners of residential property worth at least 4 million SAR. Residency lasts as long as you keep the property. Off-plan buyers can qualify with 1 million SAR or 10% down.

other: Category 2 (off-plan): one unit worth at least 4 million SAR, pay at least 1 million SAR or 10%, whichever is higher, from a developer approved by the Real Estate General Authority, no mortgage. Ownership must transfer within 5 years.
The fee on the page reads '4,000 thousand riyal', which is unclear. Confirm on pr.gov.sa.

name: Saudi Citizenship (naturalization)
summary: Rules were not readable on the official sites we could open. The Premium Residency Center says Premium Residency does not qualify you for citizenship.

other: Years of residence, language and other conditions were not confirmed. Check the Saudi Nationality System.
